"""Targeted semantic cases checked against the direct predicate."""
import json, sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import fuzz, ref_impl

CASES = [
    # empty patterns
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'match', 'path': []}}], 'queries': [[], ['a'], ['a', 'b']]},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'match', 'path': []}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'startswith', 'path': []}}], 'queries': [[], ['b']]},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'startswith', 'path': []}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': []}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a']}}], 'queries': [[], ['a'], ['b']]},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': []}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['b', 'b']}}], 'queries': [[], ['b'], ['b', 'b']]},
    # overlapping suffixes
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a', 'a']}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a']}}], 'queries': []},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['b', 'a', 'b']}},
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a', 'b']}}], 'queries': []},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a', 'b', 'a']}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['b', 'a']}}], 'queries': []},
    # contradictory rules
    {'services': ['a'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'true'}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'true'}}], 'queries': [[], ['a']]},
    {'services': ['a'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a']}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a']}}], 'queries': [['a']]},
    {'services': ['a'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'false'}}], 'queries': []},
    # empty alphabet
    {'services': [], 'rules': [], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': [], 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'true'}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': [], 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'false'}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': [], 'rules': [{'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'true'}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': [], 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'match', 'path': []}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    {'services': [], 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'startswith', 'path': []}},
                               {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': []}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    # viable prefixes (denied terminal path, but an extension is accepted)
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a', 'b']}}], 'queries': [['a'], ['a', 'b'], ['a', 'b', 'a'], ['a', 'b', 'a', 'b']]},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'match', 'path': ['a', 'a']}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['b']}}], 'queries': [['a'], ['a', 'a'], ['a', 'a', 'a'], ['b']]},
    # repeated tokens
    {'services': ['a'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a', 'a', 'a']}}], 'queries': []},
    {'services': ['a'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a', 'a', 'a', 'a']}}], 'queries': []},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'match', 'path': ['a', 'b', 'a', 'b']}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['b']}}], 'queries': []},
    # same path, different ops
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'or', 'args': [
            {'op': 'match', 'path': ['a', 'b']},
            {'op': 'startswith', 'path': ['a', 'b']},
            {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a', 'b']},
            {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a', 'b']}]}},
        {'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'startswith', 'path': ['b']}}], 'queries': []},
    # negation of atoms over the full alphabet
    {'services': ['a', 'b', 'c'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'not', 'arg': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a']}}}], 'queries': []},
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'not', 'arg': {'op': 'match', 'path': []}}}], 'queries': [[]]},
    # deep boolean nesting
    {'services': ['a', 'b'], 'rules': [
        {'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'and', 'args': [
            {'op': 'or', 'args': [{'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['a']}, {'op': 'endswith', 'path': ['b']}]},
            {'op': 'not', 'arg': {'op': 'and', 'args': [
                {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['a', 'b']},
                {'op': 'not', 'arg': {'op': 'contains', 'path': ['b', 'a']}}]}}]}}], 'queries': []},
]

def words_upto(services, bound):
    words = [[]]
    for _ in range(bound):
        words = words + [w + [s] for w in words for s in services]
    return words

bad = 0
for i, req in enumerate(CASES):
    line = json.dumps(req).encode()
    import subprocess, tempfile
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                           cwd=cwd, input=line + b'\n', capture_output=True)
    out = json.loads(r.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0])
    if out.get('ok') is not True:
        print('case', i, 'ERROR', out)
        bad += 1
        continue
    probs = fuzz.check_request(req, out)
    if probs:
        print('case', i, probs[:3], json.dumps(req))
        bad += 1
    # longer language check (bound 6)
    services = req['services']
    n = len(services)
    if n and n <= 3:
        for w in words_upto(services, 6):
            st = 0
            for tok in w:
                st = out['dfa']['next'][st][services.index(tok)]
            if out['dfa']['accept'][st] != ref_impl.ref_language_ok(services, req['rules'], w):
                print('case', i, 'long-word mismatch', w)
                bad += 1
                break
    ref = ref_impl.ref_compile(req['services'], req['rules'], req['queries'])
    if ref != out:
        print('case', i, 'ref mismatch')
        print(' mine', json.dumps(out))
        print(' ref ', json.dumps(ref))
        bad += 1
print('targeted cases', len(CASES), 'failures', bad)
PYEOF
